title: Maximum Capacity Channel
description: A city planner is designing a canal system between various vertical containment walls. Each wall has a specific height, and the distance between them forms the width of a reservoir segment. Find two walls that together with the ground form a container that holds the maximum volume of water.
input_format: An array of integers height representing the heights of vertical walls.
output_format: An integer representing the maximum water capacity.

examples.explanation: The vertical lines at indices 1 and 8 form a container that can hold 49 units of water (min(8, 7) * (8 - 1)).
The container holds 1 unit of water.
The container between index 0 and index 4 holds min(4, 4) * 4 = 16.
